resource.description: One named subject gets a card-v0 commission receipt, content-addressed, signed by did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1. Without that key: sig_ed25519:null, unsigned_reason. Check csoai.signer before paying. Paid reserve: up to 24 card-v1 references from dated /signed/card-matrix.json only; reserve_count covers that corpus. The interop root in the free preview is not included in the paid reserve. States: SIGNED or UNSIGNED. Payment never creates a MEASURED board cell. Verification is free.

signer.checked_how: read at challenge time from the Pages env field the paid path signs with; the offer in extensions["offer-receipt"] on this same response is signed with the same key, so verify that before paying

interop_collection.note: These are active root references whose model contains the query text, not exact subject identities, card-v1 reserve entries or new GSPC board scores. Check each card signature independently; this unsigned pointer and root-byte match do not prove Bitcoin anchoring. Payment does not include these references.

rail.note: A settled receipt (facilitator /verify then /settle) unlocks the paid artefact. Verification of every artefact stays free.

csoai.pricing_terms: accepts[] carries a launch amount until 2027-01-11T00:00:00Z (end of 2027-01-10 UTC). From then this request asks its standard amount, the one in csoai_pricing.normal_amount_atomic. Read accepts[] on every call; your wallet signs exactly the amount shown and nothing more.

offer_receipt.verify: base64url-decode the JWS payload part, fetch https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, take the publicKeyJwk.x of the verificationMethod whose id equals the header kid, and verify Ed25519 over `header.payload`. POST the compact string to /api/receipts/verify to have us do it, or run the same-site https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py checker. Default mode reads the public DID document; saved-key replay can be offline. Signature validity is not proof of settlement.
